en: Sepia-toned photograph of a corner wooden building on a muddy, partly snowy street. The house has ornate window frames, horizontal siding, a tiled gable roof with snow patches, and a small stoop with steps leading to a central door. Telegraph poles and adjacent low-rise buildings line the street. A small rectangular wall sign with Cyrillic text is visible near the corner but is not legible.
